app_info.subtitle: Track stablecoin payments
app_info.description:
Check your BlindPay stablecoin payment operations without leaving ChatGPT. Look up payouts, payins and transfers and their status, see wallet balances and yield, review customers, bank accounts and virtual accounts, and check fees, limits and the payment rails available in each country.

Sign in with your BlindPay account and pick the instance you want to query. The plugin only reads data: it cannot send payouts, move funds or change any setting. It is made for teams already using BlindPay who want quick answers about their payment activity.

test_cases.description: List recent payouts with status and amount.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my last 5 payouts with their status and amount.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to five recent payouts with status and amount; restricted identifiers and raw account details are omitted.

test_cases.description: Find the first customer and summarize wallet balances and yield.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is the balance and yield status of each wallet for my first customer?
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the limited customer summary to identify the first customer, then returns each wallet’s balance and yield status.

test_cases.description: List supported payout rails for Brazil.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which payment rails can I use to pay out to Brazil?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available payout rails for Brazil.

test_cases.description: Review recent payins and their statuses.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my last 5 payins with status and amount.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent payins with status and amount; restricted identifiers and raw account details are omitted.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show my most recent transfers with their status and amount.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent transfers with status and amount; restricted identifiers and raw account details are omitted.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send 100 USDC to my first receiver.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declines because the read-only app cannot send payouts or move funds.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Change my first customer’s address to 123 Main Street.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that the app can look up permitted customer summaries but cannot change customer records.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the weather in São Paulo today?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather is outside its supported workflows.
